query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                 SELECT 1 FROM pictures p
                 WHERE p.id = $1 AND p.local_user_id = $2 AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
                   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tags t WHERE t.picture_id = p.id
                                                      AND t.tag_path <@ $3::text::ltree)
               ) AS "e!"
